description: covers — config:recommended, gomod indirect security updates, pinned
action digests, the non-major automerge batch, the major-update
label — is dropped here rather than repeated. What's left below is
genuinely repo-specific; each block says why.

lockFileMaintenance.description: The preset does not run lockfile maintenance; go.sum needs it kept current independently of any dependency bump.

customManagers.description: The upstream pin each CRD chart's crdctl.yaml carries (repo + pinned_version): the version crdctl fetches the CRDs from. The vendored templates/crds.yaml is regenerated by `just crds`, so a bump PR stays red (crds-check) until it is.

packageRules.description: A CRD mirror must match the operator it is deployed beside: never automerged, a person runs `just crds` and reviews the diff.

The go directive is OWNED by devbox-update (the fleet job from truvity/ci-caller): it aligns go.mod to the toolchain triple in the same PR as devbox.lock — language minor capped by golangci-lint's build Go, patch = the newest release of that line, never downward. Renovate leaves `go` alone so the three can never disagree.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: The `security` label is load-bearing: .github/workflows/auto-release.yaml releases immediately on a push whose merged PR carries it. The preset does not set this label, so every repo wires it locally.
